assumptions.label: Revenue growth
assumptions.basis: Mean of FY2025 and FY2026 revenue growth; constant aggregate growth, no segment forecast.
assumptions.direction: Higher revenue; net cash effect depends on margin, capex and WC intensity.

assumptions.label: Operating margin
assumptions.basis: Mean FY2024–26 EBIT / revenue; normalizes recent operating results.
assumptions.direction: Higher EBIT and after-tax earnings/FCF; gross margin held fixed.

assumptions.label: Gross margin
assumptions.direction: At fixed EBIT margin, reallocates COGS vs opex; changes inventory/payables cash drivers.

assumptions.label: Effective tax rate
assumptions.basis: Mean FY2024–26 effective tax rate; no tax benefit on forecast losses.
assumptions.direction: Higher tax reduces net income and CFO, absent offsetting driver changes.

assumptions.label: Cash capex / revenue
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Higher cash capex lowers FCF and increases PP&E.

assumptions.label: Days sales outstanding
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Slower collections increase receivables and reduce CFO.

assumptions.label: Days inventory outstanding
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Higher inventory days increase inventory and reduce CFO.

assumptions.label: Days payable outstanding
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Higher payable days increase payables and CFO.

assumptions.label: Deferred revenue / revenue
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Higher contract liabilities increase CFO as revenue grows.

assumptions.label: Depreciation / opening PP&E
assumptions.basis: FY2026 depreciation / ending PP&E applied to future opening PP&E; approximate cohort aging.
assumptions.direction: At fixed EBIT, increases noncash CFO adjustment and reduces net PP&E.

assumptions.label: Amortization / opening intangibles
assumptions.basis: FY2026 amortization / ending intangibles applied to future opening intangibles.
assumptions.direction: At fixed EBIT, increases noncash CFO adjustment and reduces intangibles.

assumptions.label: Stock compensation / revenue
assumptions.direction: At fixed EBIT, increases noncash CFO adjustment and paid-in equity.

assumptions.label: Interest / opening debt & finance leases
assumptions.basis: FY2026 reported nonoperating interest / ending long-term debt and finance leases; blended proxy, no explicit debt maturities.
assumptions.direction: Higher opening-balance interest reduces earnings and CFO.

assumptions.label: Dividends / net income
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Higher payouts reduce financing cash and equity.

assumptions.label: Buybacks / net income
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Higher repurchases reduce financing cash and equity.

assumptions.label: Finance lease additions / revenue
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Increases PP&E and lease liabilities; no immediate cash-capex FCF impact.

assumptions.label: Lease principal / opening finance leases
assumptions.basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
assumptions.direction: Reduces cash and lease liabilities; increases financing cash outflow.

assumptions.label: Minimum cash balance ($m)
assumptions.basis: FY2026 cash; new modeled borrowing funds shortfalls. Marketable securities are held fixed in other assets.
assumptions.direction: Higher liquidity target can require more borrowing; affects subsequent interest.
